title: Walk a Mile in the Rain, No Umbrella | Guangzhou Heritage Day P3 | China Travel Expert
description:
Part 3 of our Guangzhou heritage-day route. Today's stop is a street where you can walk block after block in the rain — and never open an umbrella.

These are qilou (骑楼), Lingnan arcade houses: two- and three-storey buildings whose upper floors extend out over the pavement to form a continuous covered walkway. Shops sit at street level; the overhang shelters walkers from Guangzhou's fierce sun and sudden downpours alike. Enning Road, restored inside the Yongqingfang district of old Xiguan, is the city's longest-preserved arcade street, built in 1931 — and people still live above the shops, so the lanes keep a real everyday rhythm.

🧭 Expert Tip: Time this walk for a light drizzle. The arcade stays dry, the granite paving turns glossy, and the crowds thin out — the most atmospheric way to see it.

下雨不用打伞的街——广州西关骑楼，恩宁路。
